_readme: Annual fees by Peekaboo card typeId. Peekaboo has no fee data; these are entered by hand from each bank's Schedule of Bank Charges (SOBC), which changes every January and July. annualFee is in PKR before tax; null = unknown. sourceName labels the source link; reversal is the fee waiver or reversal rule shown on its own; note is everything else. Users can override any fee in the app. annualFee is the yearly cost a typical holder pays: compulsory yearly card charges (such as JS Bank chip maintenance) are included, and a fee waived for everyone who can get the card (Premier, Priority, business-only cards) is 0, with the listed price in note.
